metadata.title: Is it normal for a promotion to be given without d...
metadata.description: Response 1 of 12: Ask for the pay range of the job level you are promoted to. Also ask for the pay range of your counterparts position. Unfortunately pay ranges usually overlap quite a bit (midpoint of the lower job can be the low end of the higher one). As long as you are within your promotion pay range it may be hard to get your company to make an adjustment. When you are already at a company, it is common to be offered a promotion and provide pay increase later. They should have talked about the promotion and money at the same time, though. You could say “help me to understand…….and bring it up. You could also go back and say you changed your mind.
